description: This PHP file defines the Image class within the Goteo project, responsible for managing image assets including uploading, validation, retrieval, display, gallery management, and relations with other models. It handles image storage, caching, and URL generation, and interacts with external libraries such as Intervention Image and Symfony File components.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: The Image class manages image assets within the Goteo project, supporting upload, validation, display, gallery management, caching, and relation to other models like projects and posts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an Image object from uploaded file data, an existing Image, or a filename.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets the caching mechanism for image version management.

methods.name: setAsset
methods.description: Marks this image as an asset, affecting URL paths.

methods.name: isAsset
methods.description: Returns whether this image is marked as an asset.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the uploaded image in storage.

methods.name: getUploadErrorText
methods.description: Returns user-friendly text for upload error codes.

methods.name: getUploadError
methods.description: Returns the error message related to the image upload.

methods.name: getSystemMaxFileSize
methods.description: Calculates the maximum file size allowed for uploads based on server PHP configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates image properties such as name, type, size, and temporary path.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an Image object by ID or special fallback images.

methods.name: isUploadedFile
methods.description: Checks whether the image was uploaded via an HTTP request.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the image filename.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates a URL to access the image, optionally a specific size and crop.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type or extension of the image.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the image content, optionally resized/cropped, with caching support.

methods.name: getModelGallery
methods.description: Retrieves a gallery of images associated with a model (user, project, post, etc.).

methods.name: getModelImage
methods.description: Selects a representative image from a model's gallery or a specific image.

methods.name: addToModelGallery
methods.description: Adds the current image to a model's gallery.

methods.name: delFromModelGallery
methods.description: Removes the current image from a model's gallery.

methods.name: replaceGallery
methods.description: Replaces a model's entire image gallery with a new array of images.

methods.name: setModelImage
methods.description: Sets the current image as the main image for a model.

methods.name: deleteModelImage
methods.description: Removes the main image from a model.

methods.name: toSymfonyFile
methods.description: Converts the image to a Symfony File object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the image filename as string representation.

methods.name: getCredits
methods.description: Retrieves credits/author information for the image.

methods.name: setCredits
methods.description: Assigns credit information to the image.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the image from storage and relations, with various safety checks.
